scope: control-only candidate-owned closed source payload plus separate mode-editable state and fixed replace_fault_source_payload operation

proposed_work_order.operation_rule: complete materialized body replacement admitted only when exactly one existing fault.mode changes; source payload, source record, axes, child identity, key and initial hashes remain immutable
proposed_work_order.future_join: T1 only, fresh same-candidate source-backed lossless mapping into CandidateStatePackageV5Next

hash_layers: source_record_hash excludes itself and all content/operation/state hashes
source_content_hash covers complete immutable source payload and source_record_hash and excludes itself
initial_state_hash covers source identity, source body and zero operation and remains frozen
operation_hash excludes resulting state hash; current_state_hash covers immutable source identity, editable body and full ordered operation history
state_invariants: source_content_hash == initial_source_content_hash remains unchanged across mode edits
initial_state_hash remains unchanged across the complete ordered history
source payload, source record, four axes, child key and child contract identity remain unchanged by the fixed edit
valid edit changes only one existing fault.mode, appends one operation and recomputes operation/current-state hashes
every failure returns prior state byte-for-byte unchanged
duplicate IDs are rejected in body and operation history; history order is canonical and immutable
required_negative_controls: open/wrong-typed body, duplicate IDs, bad refs, direction/unit/cardinality, controller/fault ref or plan mismatch -> fail_closed
missing provenance -> typed_absent and terminal_deferred without fabricated hash
independent recomputation of all five hash layers
one mode-only edit changes editable body, operation history, operation hash and current state hash, while source and initial hashes remain fixed
stale source and stale state independently fail_closed with prior state bytes unchanged
forged hashes, non-mode or multi-fault change, changed source/axis/identity, unsupported mode, duplicate/reordered history, dynamic path, insert/delete/rebind -> fail_closed and unchanged state
review_requirement: different Luna independently reviews R2 before any implementation dispatch
